title: Taiwan chip distributors see supply-chain risks after Huang's exit
html: Taiwanese chip distributors expect Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO to cause short-term uncertainty across the company's supply chain, with potential changes in supplier priorities and mounting pressure from US export controls and national security...
